title: Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Return Clause: Late Returns
content:
**Return clause of the Bluegate Moving Truck Rental rental contract.**

**Late-return fee.** A late-return fee applies only when the vehicle is checked in later than the scheduled return time plus the class grace period. Late hours are elapsed hours from the scheduled return date and time, and a started hour counts as a full hour. Each started hour after the grace period is charged the class late-return fee per hour, until the vehicle is more than the class extra-period threshold late, when one extra rental period charge of the class replaces the hourly fees for that period; each further rental period started is charged the same way.

**Breakdown.** A return delayed by a breakdown recorded by roadside assistance is never charged as late.

**Extension.** An extension agreed before the scheduled return moves the scheduled return time and is not a late return.

The scheduled return date and time are those on the truck contract record; the check-in time is the actual return time recorded at the facility.

## Worked hours (hypothetical Bluegate Pickup Truck contract, scheduled return 10:00; grace period 1 hour, 10.00 per hour, extra period once more than 4 hours late, extra rental period 19.95)

| Checked in at | Elapsed time late | Started late hours | Started hours after the grace period | Charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10:45 | 0 h 45 min | 1 | 0 | None — not later than 11:00 |
| 11:00 | 1 h 00 min | 1 | 0 | None — equal to the scheduled return time plus the grace period is not later than it |
| 11:01 | 1 h 01 min | 2 | 1 | 10.00 |
| 13:30 | 3 h 30 min | 4 | 3 | 30.00 |
| 14:00 | 4 h 00 min | 4 | 3 | 30.00 — not more than 4 hours late |
| 14:05 | 4 h 05 min | 5 | — | 19.95 — one extra rental period replaces the hourly fees for that period |

- The same contract returned at 14:05 after a breakdown recorded by roadside assistance delayed it carries no late charge.
- Had the renter agreed an extension to 16:00 before 10:00, the scheduled return time would be 16:00 and a check-in at 14:05 would not be a late return.
